Two DualShock 4 controllers: one light blue with maroon accents, one dark blue.
Both controllers have protective plastic film on the touchpads.
The console has the characteristic split matte/glossy top of the early PS4 models.
Watermark 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' is visible on the image.
